lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਧਤ ਸੋਧਤ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਓ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਰੇਸਟ ਪੂਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: sodhat sodhat tat beechaario bhagat saresat pooree ||
lines.translation: Searching and searching, I have realized the essence of reality: devotional worship is the most sublime fulfillment.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਇਕ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਧਿ ਊਰੀ ॥੨॥੬੨॥੮੫॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak ik raam naam bin avar sagal bidh ooree ||2||62||85||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, without the Name of the One Lord, all other ways are imperfect. ||2||62||85||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਦਾਤਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: saache satiguroo daataaraa ||
lines.translation: The True Guru is the True Giver.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਸਗਲ ਦੁਖ ਨਾਸਹਿ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: darasan dekh sagal dukh naasahi charan kamal balihaaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, all my pains are dispelled. I am a sacrifice to His Lotus Feet. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਸਤਿ ਸਾਧ ਜਨ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sat paramesar sat saadh jan nihachal har kaa naau ||
lines.translation: The Supreme Lord God is True, and True are the Holy Saints; the Name of the Lord is steady and stable.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਭਾਵਨੀ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੀ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: bhagat bhaavanee paarabraham kee abinaasee gun gaau ||1||
lines.translation: So worship the Imperishable, Supreme Lord God with love, and sing His Glorious Praises. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਗਮੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਮਿਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਗਲ ਘਟਾ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: agam agochar mit nahee paaeeai sagal ghataa aadhaar ||
lines.translation: The limits of the Inaccessible, Unfathomable Lord cannot be found; He is the Support of all hearts.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਕਹੁ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰੁ ॥੨॥੬੩॥੮੬॥
lines.transliteration: naanak vaahu vaahu kahu taa kau jaa kaa a(n)t na paar ||2||63||86||
lines.translation: O Nanak, chant, "Waaho! Waaho!" to Him, who has no end or limitation. ||2||63||86||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਬਸੇ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur ke charan base man merai ||
lines.translation: The Feet of the Guru abide within my mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸਭ ਥਾਈ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਬਸੈ ਸਭ ਨੇਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: poor rahio thaakur sabh thaaee nikat basai sabh nerai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: My Lord and Master is permeating and pervading all places; He dwells nearby, close to all. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੰਧਨ ਤੋਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਬਨਿ ਆਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: ba(n)dhan tor raam liv laaee sa(n)tasa(n)g ban aaee ||
lines.translation: Breaking my bonds, I have lovingly tuned in to the Lord, and now the Saints are pleased with me.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਭਇਓ ਪੁਨੀਤਾ ਇਛਾ ਸਗਲ ਪੁਜਾਈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: janam padaarath bhaio puneetaa ichhaa sagal pujaaee ||1||
lines.translation: This precious human life has been sanctified, and all my desires have been fulfilled. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa kau kripaa karahu prabh mere so har kaa jas gaavai ||
lines.translation: O my God, whoever You bless with Your Mercy - he alone sings Your Glorious Praises.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਦ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਵੈ ॥੨॥੬੪॥੮੭॥
lines.transliteration: aath pahar gobi(n)d gun gaavai jan naanak sad bal jaavai ||2||64||87||
lines.translation: Servant Nanak is a sacrifice to that person who sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe, twenty-four hours a day. ||2||64||87||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਨੁ ਤਉ ਗਨੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਪੇਖਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jeevan tau ganeeai har pekhaa ||
lines.translation: A person is judged to be alive, only if he sees the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਹੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਮਨਮੋਹਨ ਫੋਰਿ ਭਰਮ ਕੀ ਰੇਖਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: karahu kripaa preetam manamohan phor bharam kee rekhaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Please be merciful to me, O my Enticing Beloved Lord, and erase the record of my doubts. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਤ ਸੁਨਤ ਕਿਛੁ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਨ ਉਪਜਤ ਬਿਨੁ ਬਿਸਾਸ ਕਿਆ ਸੇਖਾਂ ॥
lines.transliteration: kahat sunat kichh saa(n)t na upajat bin bisaas kiaa sekhaa(n) ||
lines.translation: By speaking and listening, tranquility and peace are not found at all. What can anyone learn without faith?

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਆਨ ਜੋ ਚਾਹਤ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਕਾਲੇਖਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: prabhoo tiaag aan jo chaahat taa kai mukh laagai kaalekhaa ||1||
lines.translation: One who renounces God and longs for another - his face is blackened with filth. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਰਾਸਿ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਆਨ ਨ ਮਾਨਤ ਭੇਖਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa kai raas sarab sukh suaamee aan na maanat bhekhaa ||
lines.translation: One who is blessed with the wealth of our Lord and Master, the Embodiment of Peace, does not believe in any other religious doctrine.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰਸ ਮਗਨ ਮਨੁ ਮੋਹਿਓ ਪੂਰਨ ਅਰਥ ਬਿਸੇਖਾ ॥੨॥੬੫॥੮੮॥
lines.transliteration: naanak daras magan man mohio pooran arath bisekhaa ||2||65||88||
lines.translation: O Nanak, one whose mind is fascinated and intoxicated with the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan - his tasks are perfectly accomplished. ||2||65||88||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਨ ਰਾਮ ਕੋ ਇਕੁ ਨਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: simaran raam ko ik naam ||
lines.translation: Meditate in remembrance on the Naam, the Name of the One Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਲਮਲ ਦਗਧ ਹੋਹਿ ਖਿਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕੋਟਿ ਦਾਨ ਇਸਨਾਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: kalamal dagadh hohi khin a(n)tar kot daan isanaan ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: In this way, the sins of your past mistakes shall be burnt off in an instant. It is like giving millions in charity, and bathing at sacred shrines of pilgrimage. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਨ ਜੰਜਾਰ ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾ ਸ੍ਰਮੁ ਘਾਲਤ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਫੋਕਟ ਗਿਆਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: aan ja(n)jaar brithaa sram ghaalat bin har phokat giaan ||
lines.translation: Entangled in other affairs, the mortal suffers uselessly in sorrow. Without the Lord, wisdom is useless.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਸੰਕਟ ਤੇ ਛੂਟੈ ਜਗਦੀਸ ਭਜਨ ਸੁਖ ਧਿਆਨ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: janam maran sa(n)kat te chhootai jagadees bhajan sukh dhiaan ||1||
lines.translation: The mortal is freed of the anguish of death and birth, meditating and vibrating on the Blissful Lord of the Universe. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਨਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਦਾਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: teree saran pooran sukh saagar kar kirapaa devahu daan ||
lines.translation: I seek Your Sancutary, O Perfect Lord, Ocean of Peace. Please be merciful, and bless me with this gift.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀਵੈ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਇ ਅਭਿਮਾਨ ॥੨॥੬੬॥੮੯॥
lines.transliteration: simar simar naanak prabh jeevai binas jaai abhimaan ||2||66||89||
lines.translation: Meditating, meditating in remembrance on God, Nanak lives; his egotistical pride has been eradicated. ||2||66||89||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਧੂਰਤੁ ਸੋਈ ਜਿ ਧੁਰ ਕਉ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhoorat soee j dhur kau laagai ||
lines.translation: He alone is a Dhoorat, who is attached to the Primal Lord God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਧੁਰੰਧਰੁ ਸੋਈ ਬਸੁੰਧਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਏਕ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਪਾਗੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: soee dhura(n)dhar soee basu(n)dhar har ek prem ras paagai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: He alone is a Dhurandhar, and he alone is a Basundhar, who is absorbed in the sublime essence of Love of the One Lord. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਲਬੰਚ ਕਰੈ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ਲਾਭੈ ਸੋ ਧੂਰਤੁ ਨਹੀ ਮੂੜੑਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: balaba(n)ch karai na jaanai laabhai so dhoorat nahee mooRhaa ||
lines.translation: One who practices deception and does not know where true profit lies is not a Dhoorat - he is a fool.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਆਰਥੁ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਅਸਾਰਥਿ ਰਚਿਓ ਨਹ ਸਿਮਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰੂੜਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: suaarath tiaag asaarath rachio nah simarai prabh rooRaa ||1||
lines.translation: He abandons profitable enterprises and is involved in unprofitable ones. He does not meditate on the Beauteous Lord God. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਚਤੁਰੁ ਸਿਆਣਾ ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਸੋ ਸੂਰਾ ਸੋ ਦਾਨਾਂ ॥
lines.transliteration: soee chatur siaanaa pa(n)dit so sooraa so daanaa(n) ||
lines.translation: He alone is clever and wise and a religious scholar, he alone is a brave warrior, and he alone is intelligent,

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿਓ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਪਰਵਾਨਾ ॥੨॥੬੭॥੯੦॥
lines.transliteration: saadhasa(n)g jin har har japio naanak so paravaanaa ||2||67||90||
lines.translation: who chants the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. O Nanak, he alone is approved. ||2||67||90||
